conservation.help_by: Protect shoreline buffers; support mangrove restoration projects.
conservation.caution_against: Don’t clear mangrove roots for beach access or dump trash in lagoons.

life_info.eating: Filters salt at the roots; makes sugar with sunlight. Makes energy from sunlight (and sometimes from clear shallow water light).
life_info.mating: Spreads by spores, seeds, propagules, or creeping rhizomes depending on the species.
life_info.habitat: Prop-root forests along tidal shores and lagoon edges. Forms habitat structure that shelters fish, crabs, and invertebrates.

fun_facts: Kids call the prop roots underwater stilts — and they’re right.
A living breakwater that also stores carbon in muddy soils.
